```{r}
obj <- sts.simspec.final
obj$sample <- obj$orig.ident  # change to your sample column

# Add missing metrics (human gene names; use "^Rp[sl]" and "Malat1" for mouse)
#obj[["percent_ribo"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^RP[SL]")
obj$malat1_expr <- FetchData(obj, vars = "MALAT1")[, 1]   # normalised expression

qc_vars <- c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "subsets_mito_percent",
             "subsets_ribo_percent", "malat1_expr")

# Table (Supplementary Table)
qc_table <- obj@meta.data |>
  group_by(orig.ident) |>
  summarise(n_nuclei = n(),
            across(all_of(qc_vars),
                   list(median = median, mean = mean), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))

# Create sample-level metadata mapping
sample_map <- unique(
  obj@meta.data[, c("orig.ident", "ICGC_ID","Sample")]
)

# Verify one ICGC_ID per sample
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(sample_map$orig.ident))

# Add ICGC_ID to QC table
qc_table$ICGC_ID <- sample_map$ICGC_ID[
  match(
    as.character(qc_table$orig.ident),
    as.character(sample_map$orig.ident)
  )
]

# Check unmatched samples
stopifnot(!anyNA(qc_table$ICGC_ID))


write.csv(qc_table, "Revision_October26/output/Supp_Table_QC_per_sample.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Plots (Supplementary Figure)
library(tidyr)
p <- obj@meta.data |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(qc_vars), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(sample, value, fill = sample)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0.2, fill = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
ggsave("Revision_October26/output/Supp_Fig_QC_per_sample.pdf", p, width = 12, height = 7)
```

```{r}
library(DropletUtils)
library(dplyr)

calc_seq_metrics <- function(mol_path, barcodes) {
  d <- read10xMolInfo(mol_path)$data   # one row per molecule: cell, gem_group, gene, umi, reads
  d <- d[d$cell %in% barcodes, ]       # keep only nuclei in your final object
  per_cell_reads <- tapply(d$reads, d$cell, sum)
  data.frame(
    n_nuclei_found       = length(unique(d$cell)),
    n_nuclei_expected    = length(barcodes),
    mean_reads_per_nuc   = round(sum(d$reads) / length(unique(d$cell))),
    median_reads_per_nuc = round(median(per_cell_reads)),
    seq_saturation       = round(1 - nrow(d) / sum(d$reads), 3)
  )
}

obj <- sts.simspec.final
i <- 1
s <- mol_tbl$seurat_sample[i]
bc <- colnames(obj)[obj$Sample == s]
bc <- sub("^.*_", "", bc)
bc <- sub("-1$", "", bc)
calc_seq_metrics(mol_tbl$path[i], bc)
```

```{r}
#Sequencing depth (mean reads per nucleus) and sequencing saturation were calculated for each library from the Cell Ranger (v6.1.1) molecule information files. Sequencing saturation was defined as 1 − (unique molecules / total reads).

# 1. Function: sequencing metrics for one sample
calc_seq_metrics <- function(mol_path, barcodes) {
  d <- read10xMolInfo(mol_path)$data   # one row per molecule: cell, gem_group, gene, umi, reads
  d <- d[d$cell %in% barcodes, ]       # keep only nuclei in your final object
  per_cell_reads <- tapply(d$reads, d$cell, sum)
  data.frame(
    n_nuclei_found       = length(unique(d$cell)),
    n_nuclei_expected    = length(barcodes),
    mean_reads_per_nuc   = round(sum(d$reads) / length(unique(d$cell))),
    median_reads_per_nuc = round(median(per_cell_reads)),
    seq_saturation       = round(1 - nrow(d) / sum(d$reads), 3)
  )
}

# 2. Sample table (folder name -> Seurat sample name)
root <- "~/projects/PDAC_non_malignant_cell_types/data/Cellranger_info"     # change to your folder
mol <- list.files(root, pattern = "^molecule_info\\.h5$",
                  recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

mol_tbl <- data.frame(path = mol) %>%
  mutate(rel    = sub(paste0("^", normalizePath(root), "/?"), "", normalizePath(path)),
         run    = sub("/.*$", "", rel),
         sample = sapply(strsplit(rel, "/"), `[`, 2),
         seurat_sample = sub("-GEX", "", sample))

stopifnot(nrow(mol_tbl) == 30, !anyDuplicated(mol_tbl$sample))

# 3. Run for all samples (errors in one sample do not stop the loop)
obj <- sts.simspec.final

res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(mol_tbl)), function(i) {
  s  <- mol_tbl$seurat_sample[i]
  bc <- colnames(obj)[obj$Sample == s]
  bc <- sub("^.*_", "", bc)     # remove sample prefix, if present
  bc <- sub("-1$", "", bc)      # remove -1 suffix
  message("Running ", i, "/", nrow(mol_tbl), ": ", s)
  tryCatch(
    calc_seq_metrics(mol_tbl$path[i], bc) |>
      mutate(Sample = s, run = mol_tbl$run[i], .before = 1),
    error = function(e) {
      message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    }
  )
}) |> bind_rows()

res

sample_map <- unique(
  obj@meta.data[, c("orig.ident", "ICGC_ID","Sample")]
)

res_icgc <- res %>%
  left_join(sample_map, by = "Sample") #%>%
  #relocate(ICGC_ID, .after = orig.ident)

write.csv(res_icgc, "Revision_October26/output/Supp_Table_seq_metrics.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# 4. Sanity checks
res |> filter(n_nuclei_found == 0 | n_nuclei_found < 0.9 * n_nuclei_expected)  # should be empty
nrow(res)                                                                      # expect 30
```

# Metrics from `cellranger count`.
See usage of stringi for string manipulation [here](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/28622174/extract-last-4-digit-number-from-a-series-in-r-using-stringr).\n

Key indicators are fraction of valid barcodes, reads confidently mapped to transcriptome and reads in cells.
```{r cellranger_metrics, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
cellranger.metrics.csv.files <-
  list.files(path = "~/projects/PDAC_non_malignant_cell_types/data/Cellranger_info",
  recursive = TRUE,
  pattern = "metrics_summary.csv",
  full.names = T)

# Check first: the sample folder should be two levels above each file
head(basename(dirname(cellranger.metrics.csv.files)))
#[1] "1971" "2023" "2133" "2153" "2156" "2158"

cellranger.metrics <- cellranger.metrics.csv.files %>%
  set_names() %>%                                  # name = full path
  map(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  list_rbind(names_to = "path") %>%
  mutate(Batch  = basename(dirname(dirname(path))),   # two levels up
         Sample = basename(dirname(path)),            # one level up
         .before = 1) %>%
  select(-path) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character) & !c(Batch, Sample),
                ~ parse_number(.x) / 100))

stopifnot(nrow(cellranger.metrics) == length(cellranger.metrics.csv.files))

ggplot(data = cellranger.metrics, aes(x = Sample, y = `Valid Barcodes`*100)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  theme_bw()

p1 <- ggplot(data = cellranger.metrics, aes(x = Sample, y = `Mean Reads per Cell`*100)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(data = cellranger.metrics, aes(x = Sample, y = `Reads Mapped Confidently to Transcriptome`*100)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 30, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(data = cellranger.metrics, aes(x = Sample, y = `Fraction Reads in Cells`*100)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 70, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  theme_bw()

p2 <- ggplot(data = cellranger.metrics, aes(x = Sample, y = `Sequencing Saturation`*100)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 70, linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred") +
  theme_bw()

cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1, align = "v")

p1 <- ggplot(cellranger.metrics, aes(x = orig.ident, y = `Mean Reads per Cell`, fill = Batch)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

p2 <- ggplot(cellranger.metrics, aes(x = orig.ident, y = `Sequencing Saturation`*100, fill = Batch)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 75, linetype = "dashed", colour = "darkred") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

cowplot::plot_grid(p1, p2, ncol = 1, align = "v")

cellranger.metrics <- as.data.frame(cellranger.metrics)
cellranger.metrics <- cellranger.metrics %>%
  mutate(Sample = str_remove(Sample, "-GEX"))
cellranger.metrics <- cellranger.metrics %>% 
  left_join(sample_map, by = "Sample")

save(cellranger.metrics, file = "~/projects/PDAC_non_malignant_cell_types/data/Cellranger_info/cellranger.metrics.Rdata")
write_csv(cellranger.metrics, "~/projects/PDAC_non_malignant_cell_types/data/Cellranger_info/cellranger_metrics_all_samples.csv")
```
